issue.title: Self-repair investigation doesn't follow its own search hit
issue.symptom: c2kz trial (2026-11-25), her issue gi-9168e4, transcript in /shared/issues/investigations.jsonl. Step 1: SEARCH 'two minds disagree' returned engineering_mode.py:122, the exact log line in check_general(). She never READ it. Steps 2-8 searched the code for the question's words ('SI unit of power', 'watt', "Pascal's wager", 'Gettier problem', 'ancient wonder Alexandria'), though each reply said code rarely holds a sentence and to search for a name as it appears in code. Ended 'no place named in 8 steps'. Run on Prime (GPU, base model). Ideas: when a search hits a log message from the evidence, say so and offer READ of the enclosing function; a training example of the right sequence (SEARCH log text -> READ function -> PLACE).

# candidates/gaia-common/tests/test_regression_prompt_quotes_r5z1.py
"""r5z1: the regression-test prompt lists what the bug quotes and asks for
the failing case built from it word for word."""
from gaia_common.utils.codemind_engine import CodeMindEngine


def test_quoted_inputs_listed():
    bug = ('Asked "What is the SI unit of power?", my other mind answered '
           '"The SI unit of power is the watt (W)." Both said "watt".')
    p = CodeMindEngine.build_regression_test_prompt("f.py", "m", bug, "x = 1")
    block = p.split("QUOTED IN THE BUG", 1)[1].split("CURRENT CODE", 1)[0]
    assert '- "What is the SI unit of power?"' in block
    assert '- "The SI unit of power is the watt (W)."' in block
    assert '"watt"' not in block           # too short to be a case
    assert "word for word" in p and "Assert only what the bug description says" in p


def test_nothing_quoted_no_block():
    assert "QUOTED IN THE BUG" not in CodeMindEngine.build_regression_test_prompt("f.py", "m", "agree() is wrong", "x")

# candidates/gaia-core/tests/test_investigation_evidence_hint_d55q.py
"""d55q: a search hit that writes a line quoted in her evidence says so, and
names the function to read; a quote in a docstring doesn't count."""
from gaia_core.cognition.issue_investigation import CodeView

SRC = '''import logging
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def agree(a, b):
    return a == b


def check_general(question, answer, second):
    """Says 'her two minds disagree on' when they do."""
    if agree(answer, second):
        return answer, "agreed"
    logger.info("engineering mode: her two minds disagree on %r; not answering from memory", question[:60])
    return "unsure", "disagreed"
'''
EVIDENCE = ["2026-11-25T14:42:13 engineering mode: her two minds disagree on 'What is the SI unit of power?'; "
            "not answering from memory"]


def _repo(tmp_path):
    pkg = tmp_path / "candidates" / "gaia-core" / "gaia_core" / "cognition"
    pkg.mkdir(parents=True)
    (pkg / "engineering_mode.py").write_text(SRC)
    (tmp_path / "candidates" / "gaia-common" / "gaia_common").mkdir(parents=True)
    return tmp_path


def test_hit_that_writes_evidence_names_the_function(tmp_path):
    out = CodeView(_repo(tmp_path), evidence=EVIDENCE).search("two minds disagree")
    hints = [ln for ln in out.splitlines() if "quoted in your evidence" in ln]
    assert len(hints) == 1   # the log call, not the docstring
    assert "engineering_mode.py:13" in hints[0] and "in check_general()" in hints[0]
    assert "READ: gaia-core/gaia_core/cognition/engineering_mode.py:13" in hints[0]


def test_no_evidence_no_hint(tmp_path):
    assert "quoted in your evidence" not in CodeView(_repo(tmp_path)).search("two minds disagree")
